biotools.summary: CREST is a multimodal framework designed to extract chemical reaction information from complex scientific literature (PDFs). It utilizes advanced language models and fine-grained segmentation to parse reaction schemes, experimental tables, and associated text.
biotools.name: CREST: Multimodal Framework for Reaction Information Extraction
